business.name: Blondie
business.tagline: All-day brunch on Main Street, Ballincollig.

hero.body: Blondie is a small café on Main Street doing brunch all day, soup and toasties at lunch, and whatever was baked that morning. There is a wine list too, and we will happily pour you a glass beside your chowder at half twelve.

pairing.title: A glass with your toastie is not a strange request.
pairing.body: Most cafés hand you a wine list at dinner and never mention it again. We pour by the glass from half eight, and whoever is on the floor will tell you which one actually goes with what you ordered. These are the four we suggest most.

items.note: Sharp enough to cut back through the cream. It is the pairing we recommend more than any other, and the one people come back for.
items.alt: A cup of soup beside a toasted sandwich on a plate at Blondie.

items.note: The pasta changes every day, so the glass has to be able to take whatever the kitchen decided that morning. Chardonnay has the weight for it.
items.alt: A table mid-service at Blondie — two plates, a flat white and a jar of flowers. The special changes, so does the glass.

items.note: Cold, dry, a bit saline. It keeps a big warm salad from feeling heavy at two in the afternoon.
items.alt: A warm chicken salad with beetroot, leaves and walnuts in a wide bowl.

items.note: The one red we will push on you before four o'clock, and we stand over it.
items.alt: A toasted sandwich with roast potatoes and a poached egg on a white plate.

bakecase.title: The case changes. That is the whole point.
bakecase.body: There is no fixed dessert menu at Blondie, and there never has been. Whatever came out of the oven that morning goes in the case, and whoever is on the floor will tell you what it is. Some of it is here most days. Some of it you get once and then spend a fortnight asking after.

items.name: Red velvet
items.note: The one that is nearly always there.

items.name: Blondies
items.note: It would be strange if we didn't.

items.name: A loaf cake
items.note: Whatever fruit was good that week.

menu.title: Brunch until we close, and lunch inside it.

sections.name: Brunch, all day
sections.items: Poached eggs, smashed avocado, bacon and sausage, French toast, the full Blondie

sections.name: Soup and toasties
sections.items: Seafood chowder, soup of the day, toasted sandwiches, wraps, brown bread

sections.name: Salads
sections.items: Chicken and bacon, roast vegetable, goat's cheese, leaves and dressing made here

sections.name: Hot mains
sections.items: Savoury pie, frittata, the daily pasta special, whatever the kitchen is on

sections.name: Sweet treats
sections.items: Red velvet, pavlova, blondies, loaf cakes, gluten-free options most days

sections.name: Coffee and wine
sections.items: Flat whites, cappuccinos, wine by the glass or the bottle, all day

room.title: Low lamps, long tables, no rush.
room.body: Twenty-odd seats under a row of amber pendants, a window that gets the afternoon, and staff who will not hover. People sit here for two hours with one coffee and nobody minds.

asked.title: The things people ask us before they sit down.

items.a: Yes, through OpenTable. Search Blondie Cork. We do not have a phone line worth ringing, and we would rather tell you that than have it ring out.
No. Tuesday to Saturday from half eight, Sunday from nine. Monday we are at home.
Most days there is something in the case, and a good bit of the menu can be done without. Ask on the day rather than taking our word for it now.
Come in and we will find you something. Saturday between eleven and one is the one time we would book ahead.
We will pour it and we will not make a face about it.
Main Street, Ballincollig, P31 EE73. Red circular sign over the door. Parking on the street and in the car parks either end.

find.title: Main Street, Ballincollig.
find.body: Ten minutes west of Cork city with the traffic behind you. Look for the red circular sign hanging over the door — you will see it before you see the name.

meta.title: Blondie Café — All-day brunch, Main Street, Ballincollig, Cork
meta.description: A small café on Main Street, Ballincollig. All-day brunch, soup and toasties, a bake case that changes every morning, and wine by the glass beside it. Closed Mondays.
